==Description==
The '''Body Guards 2''' was a [[Units|unit]] spawned by the [[Crook Boss]] at Level 4. In the game, the '''Body Guards 2''' was referred to as just '''Body Guards''', though it has been referenced here as '''Body Guards 2''' to differentiate itself from the [[Body Guards 1]]. As with other [[units]], it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map.

Whenever there was an enemy in its range, the '''Body Guards 2''' would stop moving to shoot at the enemies. It would continue walking when there were no enemies left in its range. The '''Body Guards 2''' had a spawnrate of 40 seconds.

There was a limit of three units per [[Crook Boss]] at Level 4, limiting the amount of '''Body Guards 2s''' it can spawn.

==Appearance==
<tabber> 
|-| First Body Guard =
The body guard to the left of the direction of movement had pale skin. It had grey legs, a buttoned tuxedo with short sleeves that had dark grey outlines and black shoes. It also wore a red necktie, black shades and black cotton gloves. It was faceless. The body guard wielded an [[wp:Thompson submachine gun|M1A1 Thompson]].
|-| Second Body Guard =
The body guard to the right of the direction of movement had tan skin. It had grey legs, a buttoned tuxedo with short sleeves that have dark grey outlines and black shoes. It also wore a blue necktie, black shades, black cotton gloves and a grey fedora with a black band. It was faceless. The body guard wielded an [[wp:Thompson submachine gun|M1A1 Thompson]].
</tabber>

==Strategy==
*You should not rely too much on the '''Body Guards 2''' because of its slow spawnrate.
*The '''Body Guards 2''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with [[defense]], like the [[Giant Boss]]. 
**However, the '''Body Guard's''' ranged damage is lowered by enemies with [[defense]].
*The '''Body Guards 2''' cannot detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] and [[Flying]] enemies, but they can still be damaged when the '''Body Guards 2''' collides with them. However, this is likely unfavorable as the '''Body Guard's''' main source of damage is ranged.
**The [[Ace Pilot]] cannot give the '''Body Guards 2''' hidden detection.
**The '''Body Guards 2''' cannot collide with ghost enemies, like the [[Soul]].
*On maps with multiple paths, only one '''Body Guards 2''' will spawn per Level 4 [[Crook Boss]]. 
**The '''Body Guards 2''' will go down a random path.
*The '''Body Guards 2''' will struggle against fast enemies, like the [[Shock]] or [[Glitch]], as they can run into '''Body Guards 2''' without taking much damage.
*The '''Body Guards 2''' is not affected by any buff or debuff.
*The '''Body Guards 2''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units, because of its low health.
**For example, if the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] uses its ''Stomp'' attack, and a '''Body Guards 2''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly killed.
*Despite there being two humanoids, if over half health is dealt to the '''Body Guards 2''', both humanoids will be kept alive.
**Both the humanoids are essentially one unit, so treat them as such.

==Trivia==
*In the [[Overhaul v1.3|Frost Invasion Update]], the '''Body Guards 2''' replaced the [[Mafia]].
*In a [https://twitter.com/paradoxum_games/status/1384922278132072449 tweet] revealing the '''Body Guards 2''', the humanoids had faces. However, when they were added, they had no faces.
